artworks.prompt: Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a great black-backed gull battling a storm wind at night, wings bent, lit by a cold flash of lightning from the left. No shadow.

Real long-exposure night photograph: a single bold, thick, very bright branching fork of lightning running from the top to the bottom of the frame, intense white-hot core with blue-white glow and several clear branches, high contrast against the dark night. Nothing else, no clouds, no sea.

Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a European storm petrel filling most of the frame, flying at night, wings angled, its white rump and the pale underwing bar clearly lit by a bright cold flash from the left so the bird reads clearly against the dark. No shadow.
